name: landed
description: A casual low-poly flying game with a procedural world and an extremely needy objective system.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js scripts/*.mjs electron/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.preview: RELEASE_VERSION="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)@$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/preview-files.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && node scripts/desktop.mjs build
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && node scripts/desktop.mjs start
